title: General Emergency Number
description: Number: 911. Argentina’s national emergency line for requesting police presence or an emergency ambulance. Tell the operator your exact location.

title: Firefighters
description: Number: 100. Call for fire emergencies. Use the official emergency directory for current guidance.

title: Civil Defence
description: Number: 103. Assistance related to disasters and incidents such as floods, collapses, and other civil emergencies.

title: Environmental Emergency Reports
description: Number: 105. Official number listed for reporting potential environmental catastrophes.

title: Nautical Emergencies
description: Number: 106. Request assistance for emergencies on Argentine rivers, lakes, or coastal waters.

title: SAME Medical Emergencies
description: Number: 107. Medical emergency ambulance number in the City of Buenos Aires and localities in Buenos Aires Province. Availability differs elsewhere; check the local emergency number.

title: Gender-Based Violence Support Line
description: Number: 144. Free support, information, and guidance for people experiencing gender-based violence. In immediate danger, call 911.

title: Children and Adolescents Support Line
description: Number: 102. Free, confidential guidance concerning the rights and protection of children and adolescents.

title: Suicide Prevention Line
description: Number: 135. Support line listed by the national government for emotional crises and suicide prevention. If there is immediate danger, call 911.

title: Family and Sexual Violence Support
description: Number: 137. Assistance for people affected by or aware of family or sexual violence; the official national government lists this line as available 24 hours.

title: Missing Children Hotline
description: Number: 142. Report a missing child or provide information that may help locate a missing minor; the official government lists this line as available 24 hours.

title: Human Trafficking and Exploitation Hotline
description: Number: 145. Report suspected human trafficking or exploitation. The national government lists this line as free and available 24 hours across Argentina.

title: Institutional Violence Reports
description: Number: 134. National Ministry of Security line for reporting institutional violence or matters within its stated jurisdiction.

title: SEDRONAR Support Line
description: Number: 141. Free, anonymous, nationwide, 24-hour guidance and support for problematic substance use and related concerns.

title: National Mental Health Urgent Support Line
description: Number: 0800-999-0091. Free, confidential, nationwide mental health urgent-support and guidance line, available 24 hours every day.
